segments.text:
ALmyghtie God, by whoſe prouidence thy ſeruaunte Iohn Baptiſte was wonderfully borne, and ſente to prepare the waye of thy ſonne our ſauiour by preachynge of penaunce: make vs ſo to folowe hys doctrine and holy lyfe, that we may truly repent according to his preachyng and after his example conſtantly ſpeake the trueth, boldly
rebuke vice, and paciently ſuffer for the truethes ſake: through Ieſus Chriſte our lorde.
